title: Resend developer-experience pair
description: A left-aligned lit title and lead over two lit, fading feature cards. One shows a sandbox send bar above a monospace log where a fresh response line fades in on top every couple of seconds; the other a webhook timeline where a new event (status chip, time, address and subject chips) slides down into place and pushes the older ones down.
notes: the feeds tick only while on screen and stop under reduced motion; static HTML shows the full lists
uses motion/react for the push-down layout animation
